diagnostic_a_hypothesis_answer_accuracy.requested: Accuracy of the Hypothesis agent's own stated answer, before the support-based ranking is applied.
diagnostic_a_hypothesis_answer_accuracy.why_not: The Hypothesis agent never states a candidate answer. Its schema (src/agents/schemas.py: HypothesisOut(options: list[HypothesisClaimSet])) and its documented contract (docs/01_ARCHITECTURE.md #HypothesisAgent: 'Out: [{option_id, claims, required_evidence_types}]') both confirm it only decomposes each option into atomic claims -- there is no ranking or answer signal from Hypothesis, in the spec or in the implementation, to measure the accuracy of.

closest_real_substitute.description: V5's own SupportMatrices, re-ranked by the raw uncalibrated (s+ - s-) margin instead of the calibrated softmax -- same underlying Hypothesis+Audit evidence V5 used, isolating whether the calibration/softmax step itself is where accuracy is lost.
closest_real_substitute.reading: If this raw-margin accuracy is close to V5's calibrated 0.316, the defect is upstream of calibration (in the audit evidence itself, or in retrieval). If it is close to V4-conflict's 0.358 (the same uncalibrated-margin mechanism from an independent run), that corroborates the margin mechanism as the honest floor and implicates calibration as a further, separate loss on top of it.

diagnostic_c_grounded_rate_explanation.explanation: grounded = pred_option has >=1 SUPPORT cell (its citation set is non-empty). V1/V3 emit a single generation pass and virtually always cite something (0.984-1.0). V5's pred_option is instead chosen by softmax(alpha*s+ - beta*s- + gamma*kg + delta*rerank, T) over PER-OPTION features -- when the calibrated top-ranked option has zero SUPPORT cells (the audit layer never produced a SUPPORT verdict for it, e.g. because it only accumulated NEUTRAL/CONTRADICT cells, or none at all on an insufficient_evidence question), citations.get(pred_option) is empty by construction (src/calibration/citations.py: cite() only draws from SUPPORT cells) and the row scores ungrounded regardless of whether OTHER options on the same question did have supporting evidence. This is a structural consequence of ranking on a fitted multi-feature logit rather than always picking whichever option the audit most directly supported.
